title: Scalar extension of filtered complexes
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $(K,F)$ a cochain complex of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] with a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration]. Its scalar-extension filtered complex has underlying complex $B\otimes_A K$ (termwise extension of scalars), and step $F^p(B\otimes_A K)=\operatorname{im}(B\otimes_A F^pK\to B\otimes_A K)$. If $F$ is finite, so is the induced filtration, with the same full and zero filtration bounds. If $A\to B$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], scalar extension preserves finite limits, independently of ring and module universes. For a complex of any shape, its canonical homology base-change isomorphism $B\otimes_A H^i(K)\cong H^i(B\otimes_A K)$ is the inverse of the exact-functor homology comparison. Ordinary and bigraded page complexes use this same scalar-extension construction.
